facts.fact: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen announced on 28 August 2026 a programme to equip all 1,200 police stations with digital occurrence books and CCTV by the end of 2026, saying it was already underway.

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior / National Police Service

note: No station is said to make digital records yet; the digital OB is announced for rollout by end 2026 and no pilot is stated.
